title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. For a field K of finite type over Q (the page's 'c.f.' is probably 'c.t.f.', corps de type fini), Grothendieck considers:
- Π_K, the profinite fundamental groupoid of Spec K. Its objects are geometric points, i.e. algebraic closures K̄. Its vertex groups are the Galois groups E_{K̄/K} = Gal(K̄/K).
- The projection p: Π_K → Π_Q, induced by Q ⊂ K.
A morphism of fields f: K → K' induces a morphism of groupoids over Π_Q, f*: Π_{K'} → Π_K, with p∘f* = p'.

Theorem 2. The functor K ↦ (Π_K → Π_Q), from fields of finite type over Q to profinite groupoids over Π_Q, is faithful in a 2-categorical sense. Suppose f, g: K ⇉ K' and there is a natural isomorphism α: f* ≃ g* lying over the identity of Π_Q. That is, for every object η̄' of Π_{K'}, p(α_{η̄'}) is the identity of p'(η̄') = p f*(η̄') = p g*(η̄'); the page draws this as a commutative square. Then f = g.

Group-theoretic translation.
- With chosen algebraic closures K̄ ⊂ K̄': the hypothesis means one can choose isomorphisms between the closures of K obtained from K̄' via f and via g. These must be compatible with the extensions of Gal(Q̄/Q), so that the two maps f*, g*: E_{K̄'/K'} ⇉ E_{K̄/K} coincide.
- With a fixed Q̄: it means the two homomorphisms of geometric fundamental groups π_{K'} = Gal(K̄'/K'Q̄) ⇉ π_K agree as outer homomorphisms with Γ_{Q̄/Q}-operators. In other words, they agree up to conjugation by an element of the geometric group π_K.

Marginal notes.
- The theorem is reformulated so that it would make sense over an arbitrary base field (of characteristic 0?) as a 'fidélité' statement.
- The case where K is a number field was 'already seen'. There it is pure Galois theory, equivalent to the essential uniqueness of Q̄.

Role in the argument. This is the faithfulness half of the birational anabelian conjecture, in relative form over Γ_Q. The next page proves it as follows:
- Write K = lim A_i, so that π_K = lim π_1(Ū_i).
- Use that the transition maps π_1(V̄_j) → π_1(V̄_{j'}) are surjective (taking the V_j regular).
- This reduces the claim to: two morphisms V → U of varieties over Q that induce the same outer homomorphism of geometric π_1 are equal.

The previous page, by contrast, deals with triviality of centralizers of open subgroups and with injectivity of Γ → Out(π). For the latter it reduces to transcendence degree 1, i.e. to curves.
errors: No mathematical error. Translating the 2-cell α into 'equal as outer homomorphisms' implicitly uses that α lies over the identity of Π_Q, so the conjugating elements lie in the geometric subgroup π_K. Grothendieck states this correctly via the commutative square.

When K contains a number field k (K not regular over Q), E_{K̄/K} → Γ_Q is not surjective. The 'outer homomorphism with Γ_Q-operators' must then be read with respect to the open image. The groupoid formulation handles this automatically; the fixed-Q̄ reformulation glosses over it slightly.

ideas.what: Faithfulness of K ↦ Π_K/Π_Q, i.e. a morphism of finitely generated fields over Q is determined by its outer Galois action (relative to Γ_Q)
ideas.modern_name: Faithfulness part of Grothendieck's birational anabelian conjecture (Hom-injectivity)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (letter to Faltings 1983; Esquisse 1984) as conjecture; full theorem by Pop (1990s) and, in the Hom-form over sub-p-adic fields, Mochizuki (1999)
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); Esquisse d'un programme (birational anabelian 'yoga'); La Longue Marche (circulated)

ideas.what: Formulation via profinite fundamental groupoids over Π_Q, with 2-morphisms lying over the identity, rather than via outer homomorphisms
ideas.modern_name: Fundamental groupoid / 2-categorical (stacky) formulation of anabelian Hom-sets
ideas.where_published: Likely in La Longue Marche text itself; groupoid viewpoint also in SGA1 and Esquisse

ideas.what: Number-field case of faithfulness is pure Galois theory (essential uniqueness of Q̄)
ideas.modern_name: Grothendieck's Galois theory: finite étale Q-schemes ≃ finite Γ_Q-sets

deep.surprise_reason: A careful statement of the faithfulness part of the birational anabelian conjecture, in groupoid language over Π_Q. The reduction to curves sketched on the neighbouring pages is the standard route. The content is in Grothendieck's circulated ideas (letter to Faltings, Longue Marche) and is now a theorem (Pop, Mochizuki).
transcription_corrections: 'des catégories des c.f. [?] de Q' is more likely 'de la catégorie des c.t.f. (corps de type fini) sur Q'.
'compatibles aux déductions (E_{K̄/K} et E_{K̄/K})' should read 'compatibles aux extensions (E_{K̄'/K'} et E_{K̄/K})'; the extensions in question are of Γ_{Q̄/Q}.
In the square, the top row is p f*(η̄') ≃ p g*(η̄') via p(α), and both verticals are equalities to p'(η̄'). The bottom row is the identity p'(η̄') = p'(η̄').
Bottom-left margin probably reads: 'On a déjà vu le cas où K=Q' (K corps de nombres) — c'est un fait de théorie de Galois, équivalent à l'unicité de Q̄ ...'.
The '{+Q+} égaux' qualifier is probably '[π-]conjugués/égaux' or 'Q-égaux', i.e. equal over Γ_Q; uncertain.
